facts.title: How PayPal payments work
facts.fact_text: PayPal allows users to send and receive payments electronically using supported funding methods and account features.
facts.explanation: The payment methods available depend on the user's country, account status, transaction type and PayPal's current service availability. Always check the applicable country-specific documentation.
facts.source_excerpt: Official PayPal information about its digital wallet and payment services.

facts.title: Why payment security matters
facts.fact_text: PayPal provides security features intended to help protect account holders and their transactions.
facts.explanation: Users should also protect their own accounts by using strong unique passwords, enabling available security features and avoiding suspicious links or requests for credentials.

facts.title: Understanding payment refunds
facts.fact_text: A refund is a payment reversal initiated by a seller or merchant to return money to a customer.
facts.explanation: Refund timing and the destination of refunded funds can depend on the original funding method, transaction status and financial institution. Check the transaction details for the applicable information.
facts.source_excerpt: Official PayPal guidance about issuing refunds.

facts.title: Understanding transaction disputes
facts.fact_text: A PayPal dispute allows a buyer to raise a problem with a transaction through the applicable resolution process.
facts.explanation: Dispute eligibility, deadlines and available outcomes depend on the transaction and applicable PayPal policies. Users should consult the relevant Resolution Center guidance.
facts.source_excerpt: Official PayPal information about the Resolution Center.

facts.title: Recognising suspicious payment requests
facts.fact_text: Unexpected messages requesting passwords, verification codes or sensitive account information should be treated with caution.
facts.explanation: Avoid following suspicious links. Access PayPal by entering its official website address or using the official application, and report suspected phishing through PayPal's security guidance.
facts.source_excerpt: Official PayPal security guidance for suspicious messages.
